stories.headline: The PM Role Is Splitting in Two — And Design Is Caught in the Middle
stories.dek: Since mid-2025, the generalist PM role has been fracturing into distinct tracks. The split is reshaping how product and design teams collaborate and who owns the roadmap.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Kelly Sikkema on Unsplash

stories.headline: Machine Experience (MX) Is the New Design Frontier — You're No Longer Designing Only for Humans
stories.dek: In 2026, AI agents browse, interact, and transact on behalf of users. Designing for machines alongside people is now a core product design competency.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Louis Reed on Unsplash

stories.headline: "Time Saved" Replaces Engagement as the North Star Metric of 2026
stories.dek: Product teams are abandoning time-in-app as a success signal. The new benchmark: if a user spends 10 minutes doing a 1-minute task, the product has failed.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by ahmed akeri on Pexels

stories.headline: PLG Is Going Upmarket: Companies Now Close $500K–$5M Deals via Self-Service
stories.dek: Product-led growth is no longer just a SMB play. In 2026, enterprise buyers are completing high-value purchases through self-service channels — reshaping what onboarding and trial flows must do.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Youssouf Carius on Pexels

stories.headline: State of UX 2026: Nielsen Norman Group Says 'Design Deeper to Differentiate'
stories.dek: NN/g's annual report finds that surface-level UX is now table stakes. Competitive advantage comes from systemic thinking, longitudinal research, and designing for complex behaviours.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Glen Carrie on Unsplash

stories.headline: 69% of UX Researchers Now Use AI — Up 19% Year-on-Year
stories.dek: Maze's Future of User Research 2026 report shows AI adoption in research has crossed the majority threshold, primarily for transcription, synthesis, and generating research questions.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by UX Indonesia on Unsplash

stories.headline: Research Is No Longer a Specialist Function — And That's a Problem
stories.dek: Democratisation of UX research means PMs, designers, and marketers are running their own studies. LogRocket examines the three trends reshaping research quality and who owns insights.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Markus Winkler on Unsplash

stories.headline: Google Upgrades AI Mode in Search with Gemini 3.5 Flash — Globally
stories.dek: Gemini 3.5 Flash is now the default model for Google's AI Mode worldwide. Information agents for AI Pro & Ultra subscribers launch this summer, with agentic booking for local services rolling out to all US users.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Shutter Speed on Unsplash

stories.headline: Alteryx Launches Agent Studio: Business Analysts Can Now Build Autonomous Agents Without IT
stories.dek: Unveiled at Inspire 2026, Agent Studio lets analysts convert existing data workflows into autonomous agents directly — no centralized IT dependency. An MCP Server integration ships alongside it.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Pavel Danilyuk on Pexels

stories.headline: AI Tool Market Shifts from Flashy Launches to Friction-Removal at Work
stories.dek: July 2026 signals a market maturity point: the tools gaining adoption are those that reduce cost and fit daily workflows, not those with headline-grabbing model releases.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Daniil Komov on Pexels

stories.headline: First AI-Designed Vaccine Completes Human Trials — A Genuine Milestone
stories.dek: A vaccine whose key component was designed entirely by AI has successfully completed initial human trials. Researchers say it demonstrates AI's capacity to create fundamentally new vaccine types capable of protecting against diverse viruses.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Iván Díaz on Unsplash

stories.headline: Google's ERA: A Research Coding System Helping Scientists Write Expert-Level Empirical Software
stories.dek: Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) is Google's new AI tool for scientists, accelerating discoveries from neuroscience to cosmology by writing expert-level research code on demand.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Mitchell Luo on Unsplash

stories.headline: 2026 Is a Breakthrough Year for Reliable AI World Models and Continual Learning
stories.dek: Robots trained on physics-aware world models now need dramatically less real-world data to perform in unseen conditions. The gap between simulation training and real-world deployment is closing fast.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by BoliviaInteligente on Unsplash

stories.headline: IoT Sensor Market Hits $29.5B in 2026 — Projected to Reach $260B by 2033
stories.dek: The global IoT sensor market is growing at 36.5% CAGR, driven by industrial IoT, smart cities, and healthcare. Accelerometers and IMU sensors lead with a 27.3% market share.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Robin Glauser on Unsplash

stories.headline: Vision-as-a-Service: One Smart Camera Replacing Dozens of Discrete Sensors
stories.dek: Multi-modal AI models running on edge cameras are collapsing the sensor stack. In 2026, a single smart camera can perform the work of an entire distributed sensor network.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Jakub Żerdzicki on Unsplash

stories.headline: SGP.32 eSIM Standard Is Reshaping How IoT Devices Connect at Scale
stories.dek: The GSMA's IoT-specific eSIM spec, finalised in late 2025, is now being adopted across manufacturers. It enables seamless connectivity management for large IoT deployments without hardware swaps.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Nick Femerling on Unsplash

stories.headline: Global AI-in-IoT Market Reaches $74–99B in 2026, Led by North America
stories.dek: Software accounts for 67.88% of AIoT revenue — analytics engines and AI orchestration layers dominate investment. Asia-Pacific is expanding fastest at a 23% CAGR.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Steve A Johnson on Unsplash

stories.headline: Edge AI Is the Defining AIoT Architecture of 2026 — Millisecond Responses, Offline-First
stories.dek: Moving AI from cloud to edge enables millisecond response times, offline operation, and on-premises privacy. The shift is accelerating as edge chips become cheaper and more capable.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Alex Knight on Pexels

stories.headline: AIoT Moves Beyond Connectivity to Autonomous Decision-Making in Industry
stories.dek: The critical shift in 2026: AIoT systems don't just collect and transmit data — they interpret it and act autonomously. Manufacturing, logistics, and conservation are the early adopter verticals.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Igor Omilaev on Unsplash

stories.headline: Smart Greenhouses in 2026: AI and IoT Are Redefining What's Possible in Controlled Agriculture
stories.dek: AI optimises lighting and heating, while IoT sensors monitor microclimate in real time. The combination is driving yields up and energy costs down in commercial greenhouse operations globally.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Erwan Hesry on Unsplash

stories.headline: Soil Carbon Monitoring via IoT Is Creating a New Revenue Stream for Farmers
stories.dek: IoT sensors measuring soil carbon unlock carbon-credit programs, giving farmers a direct financial incentive to improve soil health — while reducing emissions and water usage.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Oscar Solano on Unsplash

stories.headline: Generative AI Becomes the Conversational Agronomist — Interpreting Sensor Data in Plain Language
stories.dek: Data from IoT sensors, drones, and satellites feeds into ML models, with generative AI delivering simple action plans to farmers in natural language. The agronomist as interface.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Steven Weeks on Unsplash

stories.headline: 338 Product Designer Roles Open in Barcelona Right Now — Senior and Principal Levels Leading
stories.dek: LinkedIn shows a strong market for senior product designers in Barcelona, with roles at Lodgify (Principal, Remote), Grafana Labs (€99K), and Nivoda among active listings in July 2026.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Walls.io on Unsplash

stories.headline: Wellfound Lists Senior Product Designer Roles Across Spain — Startups Dominate the Demand
stories.dek: Startup-stage companies are the primary employers for product designers in Spain in 2026, with a concentration in Barcelona and remote-first setups. Figma and systems thinking are the most-cited requirements.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by cottonbro studio on Pexels

stories.headline: Product & Design Job Board: 27 New Product Designer Openings in Spain This Month
stories.dek: The EU Spain market for senior product designers remains active in mid-2026, with travel, fintech, and B2B SaaS companies leading hiring. Director-level design roles are emerging at scale-ups.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Walls.io on Unsplash

stories.dek: Baek, a 35-year-old manager at the South Korean semiconductor titan SK Hynix, was enrolled in Sunoo, a matchmaking company based in Seoul, a year ago. stories.dek:
Most Americans don't trust AI. It's proven that it doesn't know what safe toppings for pizza are. People don't even want to listen to AI music. But none of that matters for some of America's wealthy, who are turning to AI to teach their kids instead of traditional schools.

stories.headline: What if the Universe Isn’t as Uniform as Scientists Think?
stories.dek: A study based on 47 million galaxies found that the cosmic web retains patterns on enormous scales, which could force a reevaluation of a pillar of cosmology.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by George Pagan III on Unsplash

stories.headline: Smart glasses maker Even Realities hits $1B valuation with $150M funding led by Meituan, Tencent
stories.dek: Even Realities, an ex-Apple team building camera-free smart glasses, raised $150M from Meituan and Tencent at a $1B valuation.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Quang Tri NGUYEN on Unsplash

stories.dek: Chemicals from accidents that injured or killed people increased by nearly 50 percent in recent years.
